function consumptionHistoryBar(_FadeOutPosition, _CurrentProduceBar, _BarPos, _IsFactory)

  local Opacity = 1.0
  local BarPos = _BarPos - _CurrentProduceBar
  
  if _BarPos < 0.5 then
    -- factory does not move
    BarPos = 0.0
  elseif _BarPos > _FadeOutPosition then
    -- last bar moves out farther
    BarPos = _BarPos + 2.0 - 3.0 * _CurrentProduceBar
  end
  
  if _BarPos < 0.5 then
    -- delay factory bar becoming opaque
    Opacity = 1.0 - 2.0*_CurrentProduceBar
    
  elseif _BarPos < 1.5 then
    -- first bar has to be opaque(factory position) then do transparent and the opaque again
    Opacity = 1.0 - math.sin((1.0-_CurrentProduceBar) * math.pi)
  else
    Opacity = _FadeOutPosition + 1.0 - _BarPos + _CurrentProduceBar
  end
  
  if Opacity < 0.0 then
    Opacity = 0.0
  elseif Opacity > 1.0 then
    Opacity = 1.0
  end
  
  local Visible = Opacity > 0.0
  
  --print(string.format("_FadeOutPosition=%f, _CurrentProduceBar=%f, _BarPos=%f, _IsFactory=%f", _FadeOutPosition, _CurrentProduceBar, _BarPos, _IsFactory) )
  --print(string.format("Visible=%s, Opacity=%f, BarPos=%f", tostring(Visible), Opacity, BarPos) )
  
  return Visible, Opacity, BarPos

end
